author: Lukeeyboy
body:
Mc Username: Lukeeyboy
Reason Banned: Click Aimbot
Why should i be un banned: I think that i have waited long enough to be un-banned from this great server, i am very very sorry for using hacks on this server i have since deleted these such hacks from my PC and wish to legitimately play this game like most other people do. I admit that yes i was truly hacking on the day i was banned but as i said i have since removed my hacks and wish to play legitimately on this server now. i have never been caught ban evading nor have i ever ban evaded and i have never completed a ban appeal before because i only hacked for a short amount of time until i realized that it was of no benefit to me. so i ask you to please un-ban me so i can play on this great server having fun with my friends especially on my favorite game, Nebula,
Thank you,
Lukeeyboy
